title: Ranking: show effect sizes side by side instead of a mean rank
description: With three engines, a mean of per-dimension ranks turns any detected effect into a rank above any non-detected one regardless of size, and weights nine unequal dimensions equally, one of which is confounded and two of which come from a staged run. Replace the overall order with a side-by-side effect-size comparison per dimension, or keep the order but label it a descriptive tally and exclude confounded and non-regenerable dimensions from it.
